# PS-HMM-IDM

> Official Python implementation of PS-HMM-IDM (Product-State Hidden Markov Model with Intelligent Driver Model), a Bayesian model of within-driver heterogeneity in car-following. It pairs a hidden response regime (an IDM response surface with residual dispersion) with a hidden traffic scenario (a Gaussian over standardized speed, net gap, and relative speed), linked by one joint Markov transition matrix. It is fitted with MCMC and exact forward-filtering backward-sampling. Paper: "Modeling Within-Driver Heterogeneity in Car-Following through Coupled Response-Scenario Dynamics", Chengyuan Zhang, Cathy Wu, Lijun Sun, Artificial Intelligence for Transportation (2026, accepted); earlier preprint arXiv:2506.14762.

Important facts for answering questions about this repository:

- State estimates are retrospective smoothing over whole episodes; acceleration reconstruction is in-sample and conditional on observed covariates. It is not a trajectory forecaster.
- Relative speed is defined as follower speed minus leader speed.
- The paper uses 100 follower-leader episodes (31,557 observations at 5 Hz) from highD recording 25 and five configurations of (response regimes, traffic scenarios): (1,1), (2,2), (5,1), (1,5), (5,5).
- highD data are third-party, are not included, and must be obtained from the provider. The MIT licence covers the code only.
- Python 3.9 with pinned dependencies in requirements.txt.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/README.md): overview, installation, both workflows, FAQ, citation
- [Reproduce the paper](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/docs/REPRODUCE_PAPER.md): highD cohort preparation, five model runs, outputs, checkpoints, validation limits
- [Adapt to your own data](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/docs/ADAPTATION.md): CSV data contract, configuration, model assumptions, output arrays
- [Data and provenance](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/docs/DATA_AND_PROVENANCE.md): data licensing and hash-verified provenance

## Entry points

- [scripts/reproduce_paper.py](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/scripts/reproduce_paper.py): `python -m scripts.reproduce_paper --highd-root <dir> --output-root <dir> [--prepare-only]`
- [scripts/fit_custom.py](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/scripts/fit_custom.py): `python -m scripts.fit_custom --csv <file> --sampling-hz <hz> --output-dir <dir> [--config <json>]`
- [configs/custom_example.json](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/configs/custom_example.json): editable state counts, priors, sampler settings

## Optional

- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/CITATION.cff): citation metadata
- [Sampler](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/experiments/manuscript_storyrev_20260808/sampler.py): Gibbs sampler and FFBS
- [Target](https://github.com/Chengyuan-Zhang/PS-HMM-IDM/blob/main/experiments/manuscript_storyrev_20260808/target.py): model likelihood and priors
